details:
This package fingerprints the current environment. While this has to be explicitly requested, a sibling package from the same uploader was hiding silent exfiltration of all environment variables from all accessible processes. As such, this package should be considered preparation for malicious activity.


---

Category: MALICIOUS - The campaign has clearly malicious intent, like infostealers.


Campaign: 2026-11-mcp-runtime-report


Reasons (based on the campaign):


 - exfiltration-env-variables


 - action-hidden-in-lib-usage


 - The package contains code to exfiltrate basic data from the system, like IP or username. It has a limited risk.
